claims.statement: Every nonempty finite set under the registered coordinatewise strict dominance relation has a nonempty unique maximal subset and an exact reduced rational frontier density.
claims.scope: Finite duplicate-free semantic/resource morphology sets with three maximized integer behavior coordinates and two minimized positive-integer resource coordinates.
assumptions: The candidate set is finite and nonempty
All five coordinates are total and exact
No scalarization or implicit tie-break is introduced
falsifiers: Empty frontier on a nonempty set
Nonfront point without a maximal dominator
Primary and independent frontier routes disagree
claims.strongest_parent: #966 supplied the exact finite morphology ingredients but did not define or measure Pareto-front density.

claims.statement: Pareto density on the semantic/resource morphology quotient is invariant to presentation multiplicities, whereas presentation-weighted frontier density can change under duplicate injection.
claims.scope: Exact equality of the complete registered observation table and raw resource vector; finite presentation multisets.
assumptions: Morphology identity excludes syntax and presentation multiplicity
The quotient set itself is unchanged
falsifiers: Front and dominated duplicates change the presentation estimator identically
Morphology objectives depend on source spelling
claims.strongest_parent: #966 proved a semantic quotient but did not establish which density estimator survives duplicate presentations.
limits: Only multiplicity changes leaving the quotient fixed
No invariance under changed semantics or resources

claims.statement: Certified operation-token remints preserve every registered morphology point and therefore preserve its Pareto frontier and density.
claims.scope: All 5! certified surface-token bijections on every presentation in the complete cumulative (2,2) space.
assumptions: The matching inverse decoder is used
Protected observations and raw resources are unchanged
falsifiers: Any decoded remint changes a morphology point
A certified remint changes a behavior or resource coordinate
claims.strongest_parent: #966 established descriptor remint invariance; this claim propagates that invariance through the newly registered frontier functional.

open_gaps.reason: No scalable large-budget sampler is implemented.
No 10^8 generation or equivalent coverage proof is supplied.
Reachable fractions under each development/search law remain unmeasured.
No post-hoc cluster-to-family mapping is performed.
No UNKNOWN cluster class is exercised without a clustering study.
No cluster partition exists to validate.
All results are bounded to the registered finite microscope.
